note: Alley from the gate north between Block B (west, level with the gate) and Block A_S (east). A_S stands 1.4 m lower: a lower walkway along its west face, reached by the wide south stair from the gate plaza, the stair under the entrance pavilion and a railed stair at the planter's north end; planters with granite retaining walls between. Geometry designed in the A local frame (gen script in the R1 scratch ~/koch_work/zone_gate/gen_alley.py), world XY here. Lower-level solids use absolute z; terrain_pads lower TER_Ground under them to 5.0. REQUIRES A's FFL = 5.38 (walkway at the west door) - see the note to the lead. Old AlleyParapet_W / AlleyHedge_W removed: that fluted parapet + hedge is along A_S's south side (path from the booth), not along B.
